message.content: The claim is already confirmed with decisive runtime evidence: 70 of 71 legal-domain cases exceeded the 2e-5 tolerance (worst max abs error 0.21 vs the FP64 per-step reference, tool event t6). The root cause is clear from source: the kernel fuses 4 diffusion steps into one 9-tap sweep per axis, imposing the zero exterior only at the fused 4-step boundaries, whereas the contract requires the zero exterior to be re-imposed at every individual time step. This is an in-scope violation. Recording the verdict.
